title: docs(pm-dispatch): move clause-2 contract review in-seat — dispatching seat reviews and releases; external chain becomes optional audit
body:
Fixes #13795

## What this does

Reworks the clause-② review process in the pm-dispatch skill from "dock the PR and wait for the external review chain" to an **in-seat fable contract review by the dispatching seat**, per the maintainer's 2026-08-31 ruling (three verbatim sentences on the card; the operative one, quoted untranslated in `references/contract-review.md`):

> 「项目经理是fable 或者可以派fable的子任务都可以自己contract view吧?」

## The six substantive points of the card, and where each landed

1. **Clause-② fable dispatch mandate unchanged** — no edit. The 模型分档 section and the gate's dual-limb + tier mechanics (first 8 lines of the 条款②入队闸门 bullet) are untouched.
2. **Post-delivery review upgraded** — `references/contract-review.md` new bullets 契约判断清单 (derived judgments item by item · semver grading vs the changeset · boundary-flag disposition, recorded on the card/PR, never prose self-attestation) and 独立性件 —— 隔离复核子代理 (on a true fork in contract judgment, or a dev flag awaiting adjudication, the dispatching seat spawns a context-isolated fable review subagent: fed only the card, standing rulings and the PR itself, never the dispatch brief or the seat's own conclusions; adversarial brief — look for reasons to reject; verdict adopted verbatim after transcript tier verification).
3. **Release** — SKILL.md gate bullet + `contract-review.md` 放行 = 清标即落地 bullet: PASS strips `needs:contract-review` (both carriers) in the same stroke, cites the 2026-08-31 ruling as provenance, then ready + auto-merge/enqueue; FAIL is a patch round. The draft + label short dock at PR creation stays (it guards against enqueue before the review completes); what is removed is the open-ended "waiting for an external seat" state.
4. **External review chain demoted to optional** — the triage seat's timed wheel and the director summons become a post-hoc audit/spot-check: their verdicts are still respected (an audit FAIL flips labels back to a patch round), but they are no longer a release precondition. Landed in `contract-review.md` (外部评审链降为可选), `lanes/director.md` 职责一, and the SKILL.md director paragraph's four-duty listing.
5. **Maintainer decision box preserved** — stated in both the SKILL.md gate bullet and `contract-review.md`: a card stuck on a decision goes to the decision inbox only, never self-adjudicated; true design forks still escalate.
6. **Motivation (recorded here, not in rule text)** — on 2026-08-31 the review chain was absent as a whole; two green-and-docked PRs sat for hours (over 4h on the PR delivering #13669, over 3h on the one delivering #13733 — both remain governed by their own cards; neither is addressed here), and the maintainer had to unlock three times with personal words (the morning's five green PRs, then each of the two above). Same-tier review adds no capability redundancy; independence now comes from the context-isolated review subagent instead of from a separate seat.

## Contradicting clauses rewritten (before → after)

| Where | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| SKILL.md 条款②入队闸门 | 「派发席职责止于:卡上记一行认定、停手;⛔ 禁止自查放行。…复审链细则…见 references/contract-review.md」 | 「交付后复核由**派发席在席内完成**(维护者 2026-08-31 裁定…):PASS ⇒ 同席剥标、ready、auto-merge;FAIL ⇒ 补丁轮;⛔ 免复核不放行;…外部评审链降为可选事后审计,非放行前提。」 The invariant survives as ⛔ 免复核不放行 (release without review is still forbidden — what changed is who reviews); 卡上记一行认定 moved to the reference's carrier bullet. |
| SKILL.md director paragraph | 四职 = `needs:contract-review` 复审链、… | 四职 = `needs:contract-review` 事后审计(可选,放行归派发席席内复核 —— 见条款②闸门)、… (2026-08-27 verbatim quotes kept unchanged) |
| SKILL.md 负边界 | 「不走复审链」 | 「不走契约复核」 (wording follow-through only) |
| contract-review.md title/归属 | 复审链细则; 归属 = 常设唯一分诊席定时轮,总监席召唤兜底,标清后方可入队 | 复核细则(席内); 归属 = 该卡派发席,交付后收集复核当轮席内完成; the 2026-08-21 「你自己就是 Fable，自己就可以审核」 precedent and the 2026-08-25 「审核通过你应该直接负责合并吧…」 clearing-lands ruling are kept verbatim; the 2026-08-27 timed-wheel ownership quote is kept and marked as rewritten by this ruling |
| contract-review.md 载体纪律 | 同笔在该 PR 上向复审席账号 request review(仅通知) | dropped — there is no external review seat to notify; replaced by 停靠短暂…⛔ 无「等外部席位」的无限期状态 |
| lanes/director.md 职责一 | 兜底位,非常设处理者(常设定时处理归分诊席) | 审计位,非放行链 — audit/spot-check; the 处理三分支 2026-08-27 verbatim quote and its three branches are unchanged |
| lanes/director.md 交接台账 | …2026-08-27 再裁:常设 = 分诊定时轮,本席退为兜底 | chain extended: → 2026-08-31 再裁:放行改派发席席内复核,定时轮与本席降为可选事后审计 |
| lanes/skills.md | 契约复审链与决裁勤务归项目总监席 | 契约复核归派发席席内、决裁勤务归项目总监席 |
| landing-operations.md B | 契约复审链 PASS 落地的 PR… | 契约复核 PASS 落地的 PR…(席内清标与落地同一笔) |

**Deliberately untouched** (checked, judged consistent): `state-machine.md` dual-carrier row (mechanics of hang/clear, process-neutral); `seat-post-protocol.md` linger scope line; SKILL.md 分诊席直连自排 duties line (代裁 stays; at-tier duties still run via transcript-verified fable subagents); `check-half-states.mjs` H31/H35 (their 自查放行 refers to the *sweeper script* never writing gate labels — unchanged semantics); `ensure-pm-labels.sh` / `dispatch-gates.mjs` label and tier constants.

**Two verbatim quotes compressed to date-only references** in `lanes/director.md` (both grounded mechanisms now two supersessions dead, retained as dated ledger entries): 2026-08-23 「要不还是你挂个定时处理审核吧」 and 2026-08-27 「同意，继续」. Flagging for the reviewing maintainer; easy to restore if wanted.

## Line ratchet

- `contract-review.md` ceiling raised 51 → 57 (landed count, headroom 0). Paid in place first: the wheel-ownership bullet, the request-review clause and the standalone qualification bullet were deleted or folded; the residual +6 could not be paid without deleting ruled clauses (refused on the state-machine precedent). Ruling authorizing the growth: maintainer 2026-08-31, quoted at the top of this PR. The map comment carries the same measurement.
- SKILL.md 960 → 962 lines (ceiling 1005, headroom 43): +1 line of principle in the gate bullet, +1 from wrapping the director four-duty line to the 120-byte budget.
- All other touched files land at unchanged line counts (director.md 77/77, skills.md 35/35, landing-operations.md 80/80).

Full gate union re-run on the final commit, head `9f16a386`:

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — ✓ (self-test 111 cases; every ceiling green, contract-review.md 57/57, SKILL.md 962/1005; 120-byte line budget clean)
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` — ✓ 23 file(s) clean
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` (4 copies isomorphic), `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges` (230 assertions), `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal`, `pnpm check:entry-guard`, `pnpm check:parse-guard`, `pnpm check:bash32-floor`, `pnpm check:cli-command-ids`, `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling`, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `pnpm check:pnpm-filter-targets` — all ✓
- Edited-gate-script obligations: `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` ✓ 111 cases; `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` ✓ 1048 cases; `node scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test` ✓ (none stale/missing/contradicted); `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` ✓; `node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` ✓; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` ✓ after building @objectstack/formula and @objectstack/lint
- NOT MEASURED locally (prerequisite not met, CI-owned): `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (reads the workflow event payload) and `check-test-completeness.mjs` (grades a saved turbo test log; this diff runs no tests)

This PR touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only — internal agent tooling, no published package: `skip-changeset` applies. Governed surface (`.claude/**`): stays draft for human review per the governed-merge rules.
